### Overall Notes:
- Since I’ve only started working out during the day this week, I almost never get to drink caffeine before a workout (nor be super well rested). Most hyped up on caffeine I’ve been during a session in a while.
- After session note: no resting pain on the knee, will report back tomorrow. Might want an optional scaling of the movements for doing any plyos or squatting tomorrow if the knee pain does end up being too much.

### Lower Body:
A1. Elevated Pigeon Stretch x 20-30s hold per side x 3 sets, rest 20s
- 30s each side
- Both sides felt basically equally mobile today. Right hip wasn’t as tight as usual.
A2. Couch Stretch x 30s w/ intermitten active contraction into bench x 3 sets, rest 90s
- Also felt good. Not much to note.
B. Front Squat: 4 sets, rest 2 minutes.
- Set 1 x 6 reps @ 80% of 3RM
  - 165lb
- Set 2 x 3 reps @ 80-85% of 3RM
  - 175lb
- Set 3 x 3 reps @ 85-90% of 3RM
  - 185lb
- Set 4 x AMRAP (-2) @ 91-94% of 3RM
  - 195lb
  - 9 reps
  - That caffeine really was hitting during this. Might have even short-changed myself a rep.
  - Knees felt good. Right ankle mobility felt a little tight today, but otherwise felt good.
- *3rm - 205#
- +
Plyo Progression:
C. Light Tier Split Stance Leap - lateral: 2 sets x 10 reps per side per direction, rest as needed.
- Really mild. Felt easy, 1min rest.
D. Light Tier Leap + Tuck Jump: 3 sets x 2-3 complexes (2+2), rest as needed.
- *smootheness on the double tuck
- Ok so these unfortunately aggravated my right knee quite a bit. I think the rebound off the ground for the second jump was a little too hard, and on the third set I tweaked it to somewhere around 4-5/10 pain. I think I had trouble landing lightly in between the two tucks so I kinda slammed the knee into the ground and that caused the pain.
- Hopefully nothing long-lived, but we’ll see how it feels over the next couple days.
E. Light Tier to Ping Tier Leap: 3-5 sets x 3+2+1, rest as needed.
- *double tuck
- *building (light to ping tier)
- Had to pull the plug on these with the knee pain. Felt it even in the light tier 😕
Run/Walk Progression:
F. 10-15 Sets:
- 30s Run @ 60 minute effort
- 30s Run @ 45 mintue effort
- 30s Walk for recovery
- *self-guied on the paces
  - Did 12 sets (18min total).
  - Would have gone longer but felt like knees were feeling the fatigue and didn’t want to push them after the tweak.
  - 60min pace was around normal for this, in that 12:00-12:30 range
  - 45min pace was between 10:30-10:50
  - Overall felt sustainable. Good sweat.

### Upper Body:
A1. 90/90 ER Walkout Hold x 30s hold x 2-3 sets, rest 30s
- Felt good. Did 3 sets
A2. Cable Internal Rotation x 8-12 reps x 2-3 sets, rest 1-2 minutes
- *cable ir
- 3 sets, all at 12 reps per side and 20lb on the cable
- Cable only had 10lb increments and 30lb was definitely too heavy.
- 12 reps was challenging for left shoulder but would say it was moderately tough for right. Got slightly more difficult in later sets.
- No real shoulder pain, though some discomfort if I allowed the. Cable to take my shoulder past 90 degrees.
B. Strict Pull-ups: 3-5 sets x 5 reps, rest 90s.
- Did 5 sets of 5
- Moved pretty smoothly first 3 sets. Last two sets paused before last two reps. Challenging effort.
C. Lat Pulldown: 5 x 6 reps @ 8.5-9/10 RPE, rest 60s.
- *purposeful short rest here (keep that in mind for the RPE)
- Did these all at 130lb
- RPE was high but lower volume allowed me to keep weight up a bit.
D. DBL DB Tate Press: 3 x 12 reps, rest 1-2 mninutes.
- 27.5lb DBs
- Rested 1:30. Very high effort.
